fields.statement: QA cycle 1 with the built binary (go build at 1bae8c32) in a scratch repo, fake rex/claude on PATH: two live runs of a one-agent-step workflow, one started with run start --autonomous, one owner-attended; session records' hook reports hand-set, clock moved with RHIZA_TEST_NOW. Autonomous session idle since 00:00, owner session working since 00:00: rhiza daemon --once at 00:19 sent nothing; at 00:21 rex.log showed one send to the autonomous session's block pointing at messages/<sid>/0001.md, whose text names a background shell and `rhiza session done`; daemon.state.json nudged=[<sid>@2030-01-01T00:00:00Z]; poll at 00:25 sent nothing and rhiza inbox still listed both runs stalled; a new hook report at 00:30 then polls at 00:31 (nothing) and 00:51 sent 0002.md; 00:55 nothing. The owner-attended run's stalled session was never sent to, including under rhiza daemon --once --autonomous. An autonomous session marked done got no nudge.

QA cycle 1 with the built binary (go build at 1bae8c32) in a scratch repo, fake rex/claude on PATH: two live runs of a one-agent-step workflow, one started with run start --autonomous, one owner-attended; session records' hook reports hand-set, clock moved with RHIZA_TEST_NOW. Both sessions idle at 00:00: rhiza inbox at 00:19 empty; at 00:21 one stalled item, the autonomous run's (the owner-attended idle one gave none); rhiza run status <auto run> --json showed stalled {session, since 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z, step build}. After adding a done mark to the autonomous idle record, inbox at +30m listed no stall for it. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/session ./internal/api -run 'TestStalled|TestDaemonNudge|TestRunStalled' ok.

QA cycle 1 with the built binary (go build at 1bae8c32) in a scratch repo, fake rex/claude on PATH: two live runs of a one-agent-step workflow, one started with run start --autonomous, one owner-attended; session records' hook reports hand-set, clock moved with RHIZA_TEST_NOW. rhiza inbox (text) at 00:21 printed 'stalled run <id>, change set <id>, step build', 'has not reported since 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z' and 'next: rhiza session message <sid> <text>' for the autonomous idle session, none at 00:19; a working owner-attended session also listed stalled at 00:25. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/inbox-stalled ok.
